description: Test suite for theme resolution functions, including resolveTheme, resolveSystemTheme, and parseThemeSelection, using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: resolveTheme
methods.description: Resolves theme name based on theme family and mode, e.g., 'knot' and 'dark', returning specific theme string.

methods.name: resolveSystemTheme
methods.description: Determines the system's preferred color scheme, returning 'light' or 'dark'.

methods.name: parseThemeSelection
methods.description: Maps legacy stored values onto theme and mode objects, providing default values when undefined.
